static_traits.name: Wang Lun
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病；过去not yet有类似心理问题；not yet接受心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic; able to concretely describe automatic thinking and feelings; high cooperation, positive attitude but obvious self-criticism; a sense of tension when entering the room

basic_info.main_problem: 我因最近一次车祸（我的科尔维特被追尾）感到内疚并not断责备自己。我认为事故发生是因为我驾驶技术差。
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that self-blame and guilt are affecting my daily functioning and overall well-being, so I decided to seek counseling. I hope to adopt a more balanced perspective, reduce the burden of guilt and continue moving forward.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough / not good enough
发生的not幸It is all my fault

special_situations.event: Every time seeing the damaged Corvette or recalling the rear-end collision accident
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能避免事故或保护好我的车，就说明我驾驶技术差、我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replaying the course of the accident, self-criticizing; trying to repair the car personally and asking friends for guidance to make up for the fault
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault/我太愚蠢了

special_situations.event: Learned that the police report showed the other driver was texting, yet 'if only I had reacted faster then' still recurs in the mind
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even if the other party is responsible, as long as I respond faster and better, I can prevent accidents; I must be in complete control of everything
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 持续进行“如果……就not会发生”的假设性推演，苛责自己以维持控制感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should have been able to prevent all of this

special_situations.event: While at work想到事故，注意力难以集中
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次事故意味着我作为司机和Mechanic都not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly focuses on mistakes and risk signals, lowering engagement to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough，我的专业能力也可能not行

special_situations.event: Frequently brings up the accident when interacting with friends; tension arises in the relationship
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我notnot断检讨和承担全部责任，就显得not负责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly mentions the accident to others, seeks advice to prove oneself is being responsible
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am complaining and that I am annoying

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as reliable and competent and to gain recognition and forgiveness
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为失败者、被指责与negate自我价值
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control and moral safety through self-blame and taking full responsibility, avoiding external blame

object_relations.self_representation: 有过失且需要not断自我检讨的失败者
object_relations.object_representation: 可能会批评、厌烦或negate自己的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请其考虑not可控因素或分担事故责任时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 若not承担全部责任，自己就会显得not负责任、会被他人批评（移情：将他人视为潜在批评者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以懊悔与自责的语气表达，频繁use“我应该……”的句式，强调自身过错，弱化外部因素。

manifestations: 过度承担事故的责任，试图完全控制not可控因素
频繁use“应该”自我苛责并进行反事实思考（如果我当时更快/更注意）

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Repeatedly reviews my own mistakes, emphasizing 'I should have...', 'I could have avoided it'
担心被视为not负责任，从而将责任尽可能揽到自身
Walks on eggshells in interactions; excessive self-blame

contact_model.definition: 个体将原本欲对外发出的能量转而对自己，Suppression对他人或外界的表达，将行为或情绪Turning against the self。
manifestations: 将对肇事方的not满与愤怒转为自我指责与惩罚
Uses self-criticism and rumination to 'bear' the consequences rather than reasonably sharing them with others

positive_force: Positive attitude; willing to seek and engage in counseling
Has some reality-testing ability (can refer to police reports and friends' opinions)
Has social support (has a few friends to talk with)
Able to take action (trying to repair the car, seeking advice)
negative_force: 过度概括，将一次事故扩展为能力全面not足
Control fallacies and 'should' statements lead to high-standard self-blame
反复反刍引发Sleep and diet disturbance、Work attention impaired、Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: Intense self-blame and repeated rumination over accident details
antecedent: Thinking about driving or recalling the accident
Talking with friends about the accident
target_behavior.core_reason: Mainly attributes the accident to herself, accompanied by catastrophizing and personalization cognitions to maintain a 'sense of control' over the event and a moral self
target_behavior.function: 逃避面对外部not可控性、通过自我惩罚维持责任与控制的主观感受
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and diet disturbance、Decline in work performance、Tense relationships with friends，整体生活功能受损
